_meta.name: 03-assets-character-sheet-api
_meta.purpose: 角色/场景/道具一致性资产。电影感 AI 真人（对齐样片），API format 可 POST /prompt。
notes: 默认 ckpt=RealVisXL_V5.0_fp16.safetensors；可用 COMFYUI_CKPT / --ckpt 覆盖。
CLIPTextEncode meta.role=positive|negative，供 comfyui.retry / comfy-generate 换 prompt。
风格：photorealistic cinematic，禁止 comic/anime 默认词。

inputs.text: photorealistic cinematic still, vertical 9:16 composition, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, film lighting, high detail, consistent character design reference sheet, front view side view back view, clean studio backdrop
cartoon, anime, comic, illustration, drawing, deformed hands, extra fingers, watermark, subtitle burn-in, logo, text overlay, blurry, low quality, plastic skin
